## Risk Summary & Actions This Week

| Priority | Issue | Action |
|----------|-------|--------|
| 🔴 P1 | **SHP-009 exception** — refrigeration malfunction on PROD-003 delivery to Tops Supermarket | Confirm product condition immediately. If spoiled, arrange replacement shipment via CAR-002 (SCG Cold Chain). Contact CUST-003. |
| 🔴 P1 | **PROD-001 stock crisis** — 8 units vs. 67 units demanded; ORD-007 (urgent) overdue 35+ days | Chase PO-008 (SUP-001, 150 units, shipped). Escalate with Somchai Mango Farm for ETA. Prioritize CUST-001 when stock arrives. |
| 🔴 P1 | **ORD-007 urgent, overdue** — CUST-001 waiting since Feb 5 | Contact customer immediately to explain. Escalate PO-008 delivery. |
| 🟠 P2 | **PROD-008 expiry risk** — 6 units, 3-day shelf life, pending order for 15 units (ORD-021) | Urgently source PROD-008 restock. If no PO exists, raise one now — stock may expire before replenishment at current pace. |
| 🟠 P2 | **ORD-028 hotel standing order overdue** — hotel breakfast buffet blocked on PROD-001 | Same resolution as PROD-001 above; prioritize after ORD-007. |
| 🟡 P3 | **SUP-003 Prachuap Harvest** — lowest rating (2.8), 2 overdue POs still at pending/confirmed | Chase PO-010 and PO-016 for shipping confirmation. Review whether to reduce reliance on this supplier. |
| 🟡 P3 | **PO-009 SUP-002 still pending** — 3 days past due date, unconfirmed | Contact Northern Fruits Co. to confirm or cancel. If cancelled, reassign to a higher-rated supplier. |
| 🟡 P3 | **6 in-transit shipments all past estimated arrival** | Verify actual status with CAR-002/CAR-003. Proactively notify affected customers. |

**Bottom line:** The most urgent fire is the PROD-001 shortage driving a month-long blockage on an urgent order (ORD-007) and two high-priority orders. Getting PO-008 from Somchai Mango Farm (your best supplier) received is the single highest-leverage action this week. Simultaneously, the SHP-009 refrigeration exception may mean spoiled goods at Tops Supermarket — that needs a customer call today.
